agyos_skill.instructions: The **cultural-fluency + meme-craft** skill — participate in culture without being cringe, tone-deaf, or legally exposed. The agent **advises + writes the copy/concept**; the **human/creator makes the asset + adds the final wit + sensitivity pass**; **WoopSocial publishes/schedules** (reactive ones often posted in the moment). Forced, stale, or off-brand memes **erode trust faster than any other content type.** The brands that win (Wendy's, Duolingo, Ryanair, Innocent, Gymshark) treat their teams as **cultural participants, not campaign executors** — cultural fluency is **earned, not faked.** The meme must **fit the brand** *and* the brand must **understand the meme.** Two hard gates: **brand-fit** and **safety + IP.** **Sitting one out is a valid, often better call.** 1. **brand-profile** — voice/audience/values. 2. the **meme/moment** — and its origin. (Depth: `references/the-vibes-framework.md`.) - **V — Verify you understand the format:** origin/meaning/connotations before using it; if you must explain it, it's dead; if you must ask "is this still cool?", it isn't. - **I — Is it on-brand?** the fit filter — voice/audience/values; **"would it work without your logo?"**; niche beats broad; forced = worse than nothing. - **B — Brand-safety lines:** never tragedies/sensitive/divisive/private/appropriation/punching-down; research the origin; participation not exploitation; **if you have to ask, don't.** - **E — Earn the rights:** make **original** meme visuals (→ `image-prompt`/`design-and-templates`) to avoid copyright; no copyrighted characters / real-person likeness — **real OR an AI lookalike** (the 2026 likeness crisis) — without permission; mind trademarked catchphrases; trending audio is risky for brands → `ai-music-and-sound`. - **S — Ship it native + fast, or sit it out:** lo-fi + authentic, not corporate; the human adds the final wit + sensitivity pass (AI is a start); speed → `trend-jacking`; if it doesn't fit/you're late → **sit it out.** Memes ~60% higher engagement / ~10× reach *if executed well*; 91% prefer funny brands; niche/B2B memes convert
